name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 9 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 54 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-06-08, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
